Rapper #SluggaTee Speaks On #LilPoppa 🕊️ Passing And The Impact His D*ath Had On Jacksonville…

Slugga Tee recently opened up about the passing of Lil Poppa, reflecting on just how much of an impact he had on the city of Jacksonville and the people who listened to his music.

Describing Poppa as the “golden child” of the city, Slugga Tee emphasized that his influence went far beyond just making music. 

He was somebody the entire city could get behind, somebody whose voice, talent, and authenticity connected with people from all walks of life.

RIP Poppa 🙏🏽🧛‍♂️💜
